description: KeycloakOrganization is the Schema for the organizations API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: KeycloakOrganizationSpec defines the desired state of Organization.

alias.description:
Alias is the unique alias for the organization.
The alias should be unique across Organizations.
Alias is immutable after creation.

attributes.description: Attributes is a map of custom attributes for the organization.

description.description: Description is an optional description of the organization.

domains.description:
Domains is a list of email domains associated with the organization.
Each domain should be unique across Organizations.

Deprecated: Use DomainsV2 instead. The operator copies domains to domainsV2 once and then
reads only domainsV2; later edits of domains are ignored.

domainsV2.description:
DomainsV2 is a list of email domains associated with the organization, with per-domain settings.
Each domain should be unique across Organizations.
Settings left out keep the value stored in Keycloak.

items.description: OrgDomain defines an email domain of an organization.

autoRedirect.description:
AutoRedirect sends users of the domain to identityProviderAlias at login.
Requires Keycloak 26.8 or later. Has no effect without identityProviderAlias.
Omitted: the value stored in Keycloak is kept.

identityProviderAlias.description:
IdentityProviderAlias routes users of the domain to an identity provider.
Requires Keycloak 26.8 or later. Must be the alias of an entry of spec.identityProviders.
Omitted: the value stored in Keycloak is kept. Empty string: the routing is cleared.

verified.description: Verified marks the domain as verified. Omitted: the value stored in Keycloak is kept.

identityProviders.description:
IdentityProviders is a list of identity providers associated with the organization.
Before Keycloak 26.8 an identity provider belongs to one organization only; from 26.8 it can belong to several.
Omit the field to leave the organization's identity provider links unmanaged; set it to an empty list to
unlink every identity provider.
A list links exactly the listed identity providers and unlinks the rest.

items.description: OrgIdentityProvider defines an identity provider for an organization.

alias.description: Alias is the unique identifier for the identity provider within the organization.

autoMembership.description:
AutoMembership makes users who authenticate through the identity provider members of the organization.
Requires Keycloak 26.8 or later. Omitted: the value stored in Keycloak is kept.

membershipType.description:
MembershipType is MANAGED or UNMANAGED. MANAGED requires autoMembership true, and only one
organization can hold MANAGED for an identity provider.
Requires Keycloak 26.8 or later. Omitted: the value stored in Keycloak is kept.

name.description:
Name is the unique name of the organization.
The name should be unique across Organizations.

realmRef.description: RealmRef is reference to Realm custom resource.

kind.description: Kind specifies the kind of the Keycloak resource.

name.description: Name specifies the name of the Keycloak resource.

redirectUrl.description: RedirectURL is the optional redirect URL for the organization.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: one of domains or domainsV2 must be set

status.description: KeycloakOrganizationStatus defines the observed state of Organization.

error.description:
Error is the error message if the reconciliation failed.

Deprecated: Not written by the operator; status.value holds the error message.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation last successfully reconciled to Keycloak.

organizationId.description: OrganizationID is the unique identifier of the organization in Keycloak.

value.description: Value contains the current reconciliation status.
